Paint: textures/skins/props/head/han_a.png, han_b.png, han_c.png
https://github.com/0ad/0ad/tree/61a3b9507d974084e6badb88a0826bd89a6d5b8b/binaries/data/mods/public/art
Luanshi contributors fitted the faces and neck to the existing clothing and helm bind, retained the source paint registration and authored normals, removed fine grain and remapped the colour values for the cel lighting. Fixed upstream Git blob IDs and the conversion are in tools/art/fit_field_faces.py.
